name: Helicopter Garen
creator: exynex
description:
Changes the default garen's E sound to a helicopter, doesn't work with skins with epic tier and above.

You can download a newer version that changes God King Garen's E sound too, or download the older to keep the original sound for this skin.

If you have an idea for a sfx meme mod or if this mod breaks, contact me in my discord.

Discord: exynex

Credit to the creator of the image: ttv_omnimouse on reddit, from r/garenmains
